entities.summary: Silvestre Siale Bileka is an Equatoguinean politician. Bileka served as Prime Minister from 4 March 1992 to 1 April 1996. He is a member of the Partido Democrático de Guinea Ecuatorial. Bileka also served as President of the Supreme Court, tendering his resignation to President Teodoro Obiang in January 2004. The official reason for his resignation was "not being able to reach the desired result in terms of improvement of the operation of the judiciary". He was the first senior state official to resign, as the President usually instead simply dismissed his colleagues. He is a Bubi. Silvestre Siale Bileka was a legal figures (b. 1939). historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As Prime Minister of Equatorial Guinea from 1992 to 1996, Silvestre Siale Bileka played a crucial role in shaping the country's early years after independence. His resignation as President of the Supreme Court in 2004 marked a significant shift in the judiciary's power dynamics.
